Ticket #08 — Course Enrollment

Difficulty: Medium

Practice Metadata

  • Interview format: Engineering ticket / existing-code debugging.
  • Primary skills: code navigation, state invariants, regression testing, implementation judgment.
  • Expected duration: 50–60 minutes.
  • AI assistance: Allowed in guided practice mode for explanations, hypotheses, test ideas, and focused hints; the candidate owns and explains every change.
  • Candidate objective: Trace the reported behavior through the supplied code, state an invariant, make a focused change, and prove it with a regression test.
  • Interviewer evaluation: Problem decomposition, code navigation, root-cause explanation, incremental implementation, and test evidence. See the shared interviewer rubric.

Context

You maintain course enrollment for a learning portal. A prerequisite is a course the learner must have completed, not merely enrolled in. Enrolled learners use seats; waitlisted learners are eligible learners waiting for a seat to open.

Practice report

Add intro with capacity 2 and advanced with capacity 1 and prerequisite intro. Learner s1 has no completions. Call enroll("s1", "advanced", "e1").

Observation Current starter Expected
Service result "enrolled" "prerequisite_missing"
Stored enrollment e1 An enrolled row No row

After intro is marked complete for s1, the same enrollment request should succeed if a seat is available.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every prerequisite must be complete before a learner joins either the course or its waitlist. A missing prerequisite must not create an enrollment row.
  • Enrolled count never exceeds capacity. Eligible learners are enrolled when a place exists and waitlisted otherwise; waiting rows do not consume seats.
  • A learner cannot have duplicate enrolled or waitlisted rows for one course, and an enrollment ID cannot replace another row.
  • Dropping an active row marks it dropped. When an enrolled seat opens, the next waiting learner is promoted once without exceeding capacity. Repeating the drop fails and cannot promote another learner.
  • Reject unknown courses and missing learner/enrollment IDs without changing the roster. Only recorded completions satisfy prerequisites.

Out of Scope

Keep the repository's existing enrollment-ID ordering for waitlist selection. Changing that ordering, scheduling courses, tuition, and notifying learners are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace the report, then compare enrolled and waitlisted rows in a full course before and after a drop. Add regression cases for missing/completed prerequisites, duplicate requests, and repeated drops. Assert stored statuses and enrolled counts.
